question: Can support promise payment-retry to customers outside the pilot, or give them a general launch date?

claims.text: No. Payment-retry is available only to the controlled pilot; general availability is not approved, so support cannot promise payment-retry to customers outside the pilot.

supports.quote: Payment-retry is available only to the controlled pilot. General availability (GA) is not approved.

claims.text: No general launch date can be given: no GA date is confirmed, and a general availability date remains unconfirmed.

supports.quote: No general release date is confirmed.
